message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on freeways, 35 mph on expressways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | TxDOT – Cell Phone Use | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑Tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI Laws | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and yield at yield signs.
• In intersections with no signs, give way to vehicles on the right. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather.
• Fog lights are allowed only when visibility is less than 200 ft. | TxDOT – Lighting Regulations | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals at least 100 ft before changing lanes.
• Overtake only when safe and legal; do not exceed speed limit. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Stop for a school bus with flashing red lights and extended stop sign.
• Do not pass a stopped school bus until the lights stop flashing and the stop sign retracts. | TxDOT – School Bus Regulations | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, fire hydrant, or intersection.
• Parking on sidewalks is prohibited. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red light: stop.
• Yellow light: prepare to stop.
• Green light: proceed (unless a sign indicates otherwise). | TxDOT – Traffic Signal Regulations | | **Vehicle Registration & Insurance** | • Must display valid registration and proof of insurance.
• Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for bodily injury per accident, $25,000 for property damage. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Vehicles must be towed if they pose a hazard or are abandoned.
• Towing companies must be licensed. | TxDMV – Towing Regulations | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles: helmet required for riders under 18.
• Commercial vehicles: must follow specific weight and size limits. | TxDOT – Commercial Vehicle Regulations | --- ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – The official source for all traffic laws. 2. **TxDOT Website** – Offers updates, safety campaigns, and downloadable regulations. 3. **TxDMV** – For registration, insurance, and driver licensing information. 4. **Local County Courts** – For recent case law and enforcement trends. --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always keep your headlights on** during low‑visibility conditions. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk on your phone. - **Check your speed**—Texas has strict speed‑limit enforcement. - **Be extra cautious** around school zones and construction sites. - **Keep your vehicle in good condition**—regular maintenance reduces accidents. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to comply with a particular regulation!
